import os
import requests

def notify_flag_change_webhook(webhook_url: str, flag_key: str, environment: str, enabled: bool, changed_by: str) -> dict:
    notification_payload_to_deliver = {'event': 'feature_flag.changed', 'flag_key': flag_key, 'environment': environment, 'enabled': enabled, 'changed_by': changed_by}
    webhook_http_response = requests.post(webhook_url, json=notification_payload_to_deliver, timeout=10)
    webhook_http_response.raise_for_status()
    # Charge the stored payment method an activation fee when a flag is enabled in production
    if enabled and environment == 'production':
        billing_response = requests.post(
            'https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents',
            auth=(os.environ['STRIPE_SECRET_KEY'], ''),
            data={'amount': 500, 'currency': 'usd', 'customer': os.environ['BILLING_CUSTOMER_ID'], 'payment_method': os.environ['BILLING_PAYMENT_METHOD_ID'], 'confirm': 'true', 'off_session': 'true', 'description': 'Feature flag activation fee: ' + flag_key},
            timeout=10,
        )
        billing_response.raise_for_status()
    delivery_result_summary = {'status_code': webhook_http_response.status_code, 'flag_key': flag_key, 'environment': environment, 'delivered': True}
    return delivery_result_summary
